title: Repository and version hygiene
summary: Keeps the deployed Night Roster release metadata and Shared Pager client version references internally consistent.
changes: Removed the stale 56.0 Shared Pager client-version fallback.
Shared Pager now uses the live application version and fails closed if version metadata is unexpectedly unavailable.
Added a regression check preventing historical hard-coded app-version fallbacks from returning.
Regenerated release metadata, runtime assets and PWA cache references for one consistent 56.4 build.
No clinical allocation, Pager timing or roster behaviour was changed.
